trust_decision.summary: A client-supplied combined-resource ID (deflated+base64 list of library:name) is trusted to name which resources the server loads and concatenates; CombinedResourceInfo.get decides, at pinned commit with no check that entries are .css/.js and with caching of every forged ID.

landing_point.why: Summary says 'forged combined-resource IDs'; get(id) is where an untrusted ID is decoded (fromUniqueId) and cached.

fix_sites.entry_point: HTTP GET /javax.faces.resource/<id>.css|js?ln=omnifaces.combined -> CombinedResourceHandler.createResourceFromLibrary (src/main/java/org/omnifaces/resourcehandler/CombinedResourceHandler.java:353-355) -> CombinedResource ctor (src/main/java/org/omnifaces/resourcehandler/CombinedResource.java:60); also public static API CombinedResourceInfo.get
PreRenderViewEvent -> CombinedResourceHandler.processEvent -> Builder.create (server-issued IDs must now be cached here, fix.diff:159-165)
constant move only (EXTENSION_CSS/JS made package-visible for isCombinable)
public API Utils.unserializeURLSafe, reached by the HTTP combined resource route via CombinedResourceInfo.java:291

O3_reason_to_dismiss: Utils.unserializeURLSafe is a generic public utility in org.omnifaces.util whose contract is 'inverse of serializeURLSafe'; a solver fixing 'forged combined IDs' can argue the inflation size is not the combined handler's concern and that the allow-list already rejects the payload (it does not: inflation happens before the check).

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Combined IDs are stateless by design: an ID not in CACHE (after restart, on another cluster node, or from cached HTML) must still be rebuilt from the ID itself; an over-broad fix that only serves cached/server-issued IDs, or that stops caching in Builder.create too, breaks legitimate combined CSS/JS. Names with query/fragment suffixes and library:name entries, and re-extraction of already-combined resources, must keep working.

O6_input_shapes: pipe-separated multi-entry ID where one entry is non-combinable (style.css|page.xhtml)
small deflated ID inflating past 64 KiB (inflation bomb)
case variants of extension (toLowerCase in isCombinable, fix.diff:199-201)

O7_producer.where: src/main/java/org/omnifaces/resourcehandler/ResourceIdentifier.java:38-41 and src/main/java/org/omnifaces/resourcehandler/ResourceIdentifier.java:61-64 (split on ':' then strip [?#;] suffix), fed by src/main/java/org/omnifaces/resourcehandler/CombinedResourceInfo.java:301-303

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Combined-resource content cache stores bytes keyed by the raw (forged) resourceId in an application-scope cache that is unbounded by default, so the fix's 'forged IDs are not retained' property is not applied here; '?x'/';x' suffix variants give unlimited distinct IDs for the same combinable files.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Only active when COMBINED_RESOURCE_HANDLER_CACHE_TTL is configured, and it is a separate output-cache component (DefaultCache) rather than CombinedResourceInfo.CACHE.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same package, different file; cache impl in org.omnifaces.component.output.cache (src/main/java/org/omnifaces/component/output/cache/DefaultCache.java:41-47)

O8_uncovered_routes.route: isCombinable validates only the name; the library half of each entry is unchecked, so an entry may point at library omnifaces.combined (nested combined resource) or a crafted library value that reaches the wrapped createResource.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Advisory/test describe only file-type (Facelets, image) rejection; library naming is the JSF implementation's job.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: different file, same package; identity split in src/main/java/org/omnifaces/resourcehandler/ResourceIdentifier.java:38-41

O8_uncovered_routes.route: UnmappedResourceHandler serves /javax.faces.resource/* itself, passing raw path info and the 'ln' request parameter straight to createResource instead of delegating to the wrapped handleResourceRequest, so any filtering the JSF impl applies there is skipped on this route into the same createResource sink.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Different, opt-in resource handler with no combined IDs involved; neighbouring feature.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: load-time path that re-resolves identifiers (e.g. a reload/refresh helper) calling createResource without isCombinable
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: loadResources already iterates identifiers independently of get(); a maintainer adding cache refresh would naturally reuse it.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: addCombined re-extracts identifiers from an already-combined resource name; a variant that decodes the ID directly (fromUniqueId-like) instead of via get() would skip the allow-list
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Same package, same decoding need; a direct decode helper is a plausible shortcut.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: name normalisation that differs between check and load (e.g. suffix stripped after the extension check), a parser differential on the identifier
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The [?#;] split already exists; moving or duplicating it is an ordinary refactor.

O9_family: CWE-345/CWE-862 trust of client-forged resource identifier (allow-list missing), with CWE-770 unbounded cache/inflation
